name: The Artificer specialization replaces Unmake with Artificer's Wand (#515)
contract: Artificer's Wand 804478 reads that the wand specialization replaces Unmake with the Artificer's Wand chain. The mechanism is data, not a spell effect: AscensionCompatData::TalentReplacements (AscensionTalentReplacementData.h:60) carries the row {22, 33, 804478, 804418, {{561284 at 0, 561354 at 22, 561355 at 32, 561356 at 42, 561357 at 52}}}, and AscensionClassService::SynchronizeTalentReplacements (AscensionCompat.cpp:788-863) grants the highest rank whose required level the character has reached and registers it through Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement. Three conditions gate it (AscensionCompat.cpp:802): the active local specialization must be 33, the character must know the parent 804478, and it must hold an active spell whose chain root is the original 804418 - spell_ranks makes 804418 the root of 503784-503790, 504574, 574344 and 574345. The replacement is registered against the Unmake rank the character actually has active, not against the root: the loop only assigns to ids for which Player::HasActiveSpell is true, so 574345 - the top rank, AscensionProgression's level-60 entry - is the one that carries it at level 80, and 561357 is the matching Artificer's Wand rank for level 52 and above. Two observations from a diagnostic run on the slot shape the assertions. First, the unreplaced reading of temporary_spell_replacement is the queried spell id, not zero: Player::GetTemporarySpellReplacement (Player.cpp:13780-13784) returns `original` whenever the map has no entry for it, and SetTemporarySpellReplacement stores `original` back as the previous value when a replacement is cleared. Second, the talent cannot be unknown while specialization 33 is active: `.localspec 33` runs the class service's progression synchronisation, which grants 804478 itself, so the 'talent unknown' baseline has to be taken before the specialization is switched, not after. A level-80 Chronomancer knows the root 804418 at login, but AscensionClassService::SynchronizeProgression learns AscensionProgression::Ranks entries only when CoA.AutoProgression is 1 (default 0, src/server/coa/conf/coa.conf.dist) or on an explicit Book of Ascension request, so GiveLevel(80) leaves 574345 unlearned; the fixture teaches it with a learn step, which also supersedes the lower active rank, and asserts it rather than assuming it. The discriminating assertion is the one taken after the specialization is active: before it, the same metric reads 574345 - Unmake standing in for itself - which the scenario also asserts.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Progression already granted the Unmake root
Fixture teaches Unmake's top rank (CoA.AutoProgression = 0 by default, so GiveLevel(80) does not grant it; real play acquires it from a Book of Ascension)
Unmake's top rank, the one the replacement has to land on at level 80, is known
The Artificer's Wand talent is not known before the specialization is chosen
Nothing replaces Unmake while the specialization is inactive, so the metric reads Unmake itself
The Artificer's Wand rank is not in the spellbook either
Specialization 33 is active, shown by its own tuning aura
The specialization granted its own Artificer's Wand talent
The active specialization replaces Unmake with the level-appropriate Artificer's Wand rank
The replacement rank was granted to the spellbook as well
